ety.text: Borrowed from Sanskrit वैयक्तिक (vaiyaktika), a vrddhi-derivative of व्यक्ति (vyakti, “individual”).
Learned borrowing from Sanskrit सर्वसाधारण (sarvasādhāraṇa). By surface analysis, सर्व (sarv, “all”) + साधारण (sādhāraṇ, “common, usual”).
